name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 1; Directive 2003/87/EC – Article 10a – § 2a – after sub§ 2 – 11
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030
part_text: The additional free allocation pursuant to the first and second subparagraphs of this paragraph shall be made only to the extent that the allowances required for this purpose are available in accordance with the third subparagraph of this paragraph, without requiring a reduction in the free allocation to other installations through the application of the uniform cross-sectoral correction factor pursuant to paragraph 5. If the additional quantity of allowances required to implement the first and second subparagraphs exceeds the quantity available for that purpose, the additional allocation shall be uniformly capped on a pro rata basis to the extent necessary. The Commission shall specify the necessary adjustments in the implementing acts referred to in paragraph 2. In doing so, it shall ensure that allowances are not counted more than once and that the applicable caps on free allocation are respected.
